title: BMW M2
author: Manuel Contento

configuration.name: BMW M2 Coupé
configuration.variant: Original M2 / N55, pre-LCI exterior; not M2 Competition
configuration.modelYearSelection: 2016–2017 exterior is the best fit. Exact trim and gearbox are not encoded in the creator's title.
identityEvidence: Public creator preview directly inspected: separated chrome kidney grilles, circular xenon-style corona rings, original M2 front bumper, original-style wheels and blue brake calipers.
Compared with BMW's official 2016 M2 photograph; matching body and front fascia.
Model published 2018-02-12, before BMW's 2018-04 M2 Competition announcement; Competition has enlarged black kidney grilles and revised front apron.
configuration.visualCaveat: Creator uses a decorative red/blue livery. If stock appearance is desired, replace/remove the livery material while preserving the intended body form and documenting edits.

creationEvidence: Creator describes it as a high-poly model made in free time to practice modeling, modeled in Autodesk Maya and textured in Substance Painter.
usage: Ordinary deterministic mesh conversion and game rendering.

download.method: Public GitHub mirror documents acquisition using the normal Sketchfab Data API download endpoint. The file is a processed derivative, not byte-identical to the creator's upload.

changes: Decoded Meshopt compression and normalized quantized attributes using glTF-Transform and meshoptimizer.
Removed only the two-triangle Piano studio ground plane; retained all 228,676 vehicle triangles in the main model.
Rotated source forward +Z and up +Y to runtime forward +X, right +Y, up +Z with a proper rotation; corrected any mirrored node winding.
Scaled uniformly to 4.468 m length and placed the lowest tire geometry at ground zero. Source width and height proportions are preserved.
Kept the six original 1024x1024 base-color images byte-for-byte, including the artist red/blue decorative livery. No additional vehicle paint tint.

Adapted reflective paint, opaque cabin glazing, transparent lamp covers, metal, and light-guide materials to the existing exterior renderer. Metallic/roughness and normal-map textures are not consumed by this renderer.
Created a separate approximately 6,000-triangle fallback using deterministic Meshopt simplification and source-texture sampled colors.
Combined matching draw groups, compacted unused vertices, retained source smooth normals/UVs, and embedded data in a local gzip-compressed runtime.

visualReferences.role: Official BMW 2016 M2 image for visual comparison only; not a redistributable game asset under the model CC license
